Container.Name: Omni
Container.Overview: Single-instance Sidero Omni with embedded etcd for homelab and non-production use. Run setup.sh before installing this template. Omni requires an OIDC provider; install the optional Omni-Dex template for a local login or configure Authentik/generic OIDC. The upstream image is minimal and intentionally has no interactive console shell.

Config.Name: Omni Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Omni configuration, certificates, embedded etcd, and SQLite data. Run setup.sh against this exact host path first.

Config.Name: TLS trust bundle
Config.Description: Trust bundle generated by setup.sh. Append any private CA used by an external OIDC provider.
